components.css: .ds-floor-info{background:var(--panel,#202020);color:var(--text,#f4f2ed);padding:clamp(28px,4vw,60px);border-radius:0}.ds-floor-info h3{font:600 clamp(38px,4vw,56px)/.98 "Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;max-width:11ch;margin:0 0 22px}.ds-floor-info p{font:400 14px/1.75 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#b6b5b0);margin:0 0 26px}.ds-floor-info dl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:24px;margin:0;font:400 12px Manrope,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-floor-info dt{color:var(--muted,#b6b5b0);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:8px}.ds-floor-info dd{margin:0}

components.name: Selected Floor Tab
components.description: Condensed material selector, coral selection line, and directional arrow; production JavaScript manages tab activation.
components.css: .ds-tab{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;width:100%;padding:24px 0;background:transparent;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,rgba(244,242,237,.18));border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,rgba(244,242,237,.18));color:var(--muted,#b6b5b0);font:600 32px "Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-tab:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-1px;height:3px;left:0;width:0;background:var(--accent,#ff725e);transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]{color:var(--text,#f4f2ed)}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]:after{width:100%}.ds-tab span{display:flex}.ds-tab svg{width:24px;height:24px;opacity:0;transform:translate(-6px,6px);transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true] svg,.ds-tab:hover svg{opacity:1;transform:none}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#ff725e);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tab:after,.ds-tab svg{transition:none}}

Can I book a DJ as well?+

components.css: .ds-faq{border-top:1px solid var(--line,rgba(244,242,237,.18));border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,rgba(244,242,237,.18));color:var(--text,#f4f2ed);font-family:Manrope,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-faq summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;padding:26px 0}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq summary span{font-size:28px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent,#ff725e);transition:transform .25s}.ds-faq[open] summary span{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#ff725e);outline-offset:6px}.ds-faq p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted,#b6b5b0);padding-right:24px;margin:0 0 26px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-faq summary span{transition:none}}

narrative.northStar: The dance floor as a stage.
narrative.overview: A bold event editorial for Elite Surfaces, created for Vessel Archive. Oversized condensed statements, original event photography, charcoal surfaces, warm white, and vivid coral make celebrations feel immediate. Quiet supporting copy keeps the experience readable.

rules.name: The Image Contrast Rule
rules.body: Preserve photographic overlays; check headline readability after changing crops or copy.

rules.name: The Statement Rule
rules.body: Reserve condensed type for major statements and headings; use Manrope for explanations and controls.

dos: Do retain expressive type, original photography, sharp surfaces, and rounded controls.
Do preserve both color preferences, keyboard states, visible labels, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don’t turn editorial sections into repetitive floating cards.
Don’t apply pill corners to photographs.
